I appreciate that this helps keep my sponge clean in my makeup bag, but also the air holes that allow my sponge to dry because I do use it damp. I was having issues with my sponges molding… but have not had that problem since I started using this! Before I was using a hard plastic case that came with my RT

It's easy to wipe down or clean make up left on the surface. It's most useful for protecting sponge from impurities but also the makeup sponge from leaving make up stains on other cosmetic tools. This is a product you’ll say “why didn’t I think of that!” I do a lot of traveling and my makeup sponge was making a mess on everything else in my bag. This item fits great in my bag and now I don’t have a mess!  The design also allows the sponge to breath! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

My bf and I are medium distance and I pack up every weekend to see him, this is such a life saver! For the listener I was just throwing my sponges in a loose bag, this actually protects them and makes them easy to find!

reviews.t: Perfect for protecting my beauty blender
reviews.x: I got tired of my beauty blenders getting dirty and ruined in my makeup bag. This holder is perfect for storing my sponges. They are a bit bulky but totally worth it to protect the longevity of my sponges. Love!!
Very pretty and it holds my real techniques beauty blender!

I am in love with this beauty sponge container. I was using the Real Techniques beauty sponger container but it only fit “slanted” beauty blenders (it also is an ugly orange and didn’t fit my aesthetic 🤣). This holder can hold any shape of a beauty sponge, dry or wet! Easy to wipe off & such a cute color 🤎 I ordered the holder in Khaki

I use this everyday. I was always struggling to place clean sponges someplace. The vents allow it to air dry and it protects it for travel. I can get about x2 of the Beauty blenders inside...3 if you push them in there.

reviews.t: It does what it’s supposed to…
reviews.x: It’s a pretty good size and the quality it nice. I believe any standard size makeup sponge can fit in it.

reviews.t: The thing you might not have known you needed
reviews.x: Exactly as described.  I can easily pop my sponge in and out.  Very handy product.

The problem with that is I would always throw them away or lose them. I was on the fence to purchase it because the price. I was thinking if I was able to find something for less. But I figured let me try it out. And let me tell you I’m so glad I did!!!! I love that it’s silicone, it’s easy to wash and it can hold just about

reviews.t: No more bacteria on make up sponges :-)
reviews.x: This is such an awesome product I bought two. I’m thinking of purchasing more as well. I love that I can wash a beauty blender or a makeup sponge of any kind and let it dry in here as well as take it in my purse. I also love that after I use the sponge to apply foundation I can put it in here and it doesn’t get the rest of my make up bag processor foundation. It protects my sponge and also protects the other items in my bag. I’m so happy with this product. I wish I had more colors!

I love this thing!! I used to find myself being so frustrated just throwing my makeup spong in a cosmetic bag for trips because makeup would get all over!! But this thing is so awesome!!! It’s so easy to use and doesn’t open if you don’t open it manually. So it won’t slip out in your bag. It even fits my beauty blenders that are slightly bigger than the ‘real techniques’ ones. Absolutely love it!

reviews.t: Great product, just not for me
reviews.x: This product was exactly as pictured/described and had no issues. I just came to realize that it’s not the best for a WET beauty blender. I tend to toss mine in my bag and use it on the go, and with my ADHD 😅 I forget about it and it holds moisture/germs. This would be great for packing to take on a trip, a dry beauty blender, etc.

Great product for traveling or just to have in your makeup bag to keep your sponges clean and in one place. I can fit 2 to 3 of the small real techniques beauty sponges when I travel. I don’t have a normal size beauty blender or sponges but if I can fit 2 or 3 smaller size you can definitely fit a regular size one.

This is super useful for holding my beauty blender when I’m traveling instead of just tossing it into my makeup bag. It’s a flexible material so it’s easy to get the sponge in and out. The color looks a little different than pictured - it’s more of a dark tan than pink.

I think the idea of this product is fantastic. I recommend getting a color that isn’t black though. The makeup gets all over the outside and is just kind of ugly to look at. Other than that, it’s good. I’m sure a different color may be different though!

reviews.t: Does what it says it does
reviews.x: Regular beauty blenders fit well in it. I hated putting my beauty blenders on the counter or vanity while they are still wet, got this so I can put them in to dry. Also good for traveling so every thing isn’t getting on the blender

I bought this for traveling. I bought a new smaller makeup bag for travel and didn’t want to get the inside dirty. It’s a little bigger than I thought it was going to be but it’s super cute and fits my beauty blender nicely.

I love this product! It gives my sponges the chance to dry instead of putting a wet sponge into my makeup bag and keeps it from getting dirty! But I wanted the tan color but received the brown. But still love the product !

I bought this to have a portable sponge holder for when I went on a work trip. It definitely kept my sponge damp for two days so I didn’t have to re wet it again. Fits perfectly in any bag container for travel. Love it

reviews.t: Big things come in little packages!
reviews.x: Such a cute little container for the small facial sponges that are now being used for cosmetics. Easily fits one or two sponges and is especially helpful for use when traveling. Very happy I discovered this little gem!
This product is actually very useful! I would’ve given it 5 stars if it wasn’t for the smell of the beauty blender. It smelled like sharpie at first but after letting it sit out the smell wore off!

claims.text: Reviewers love that the holder keeps their makeup sponges clean and protected, especially in makeup bags and while traveling.
The holder is easy to use, with a soft, pliable silicone design that opens with a squeeze and is easy to wipe clean.
The air holes/vents allow sponges to breathe and air dry, which many reviewers appreciate.
It fits most standard sponge sizes and shapes, including Real Techniques and Beauty Blenders, and can hold multiple sponges.
A few reviewers note the holder is a bit bulky, though they consider it worth it for protecting their sponges.
